summary: Iteration 34 — Uber-style live tracking (POST accept/location/status, GET tracking, quote-accept notification) + NavBar Sign-in overflow fix + ProviderHub 'Not interested' (dismiss) persistence. All backend tests PASSED (6/6) and every spec'd frontend behavior PASSED.

verified_behaviors.B2_location_endpoint: PASS — provider-only (customer→403); valid ping stores provider_live_location {lat,lng,heading,speed,updated_at}; after job completed, further pings return 400.
verified_behaviors.B3_status_endpoint: PASS — invalid status→400; non-assigned-provider caller (customer)→403; on_the_way/arrived/in_progress/completed accepted; in_progress flips job.status to in_progress; completed flips job.status to completed and sets completed_at; customer receives tracking_{status} notifications.
verified_behaviors.B4_get_tracking_payload_and_eta: PASS — payload contains tracking_status, tracking_timestamps, provider_live_location, destination (=dropoff), pickup/dropoff, eta_minutes, job_status, job_title. ETA matches haversine_miles/25 mph * 60 within 0.2 min tolerance. RBAC: customer & assigned provider 200, admin/third-party 403.

verified_behaviors.F4_status_button_polling_5s: PASS — clicking set-status-on_the_way → pill updates to 'On the way' within 5-7 s of polling. No JS console errors during the geolocation pinger lifecycle.
verified_behaviors.F5_customer_tracker_view: PASS — customer sees status pill, ETA, Last ping label, chat aside; provider-status-actions hidden as expected.
verified_behaviors.F6_jobdetail_track_link: PASS — data-testid=job-detail-track-link visible for assigned job (TRACK LIVE → button rendered on JobDetail header).

verified_behaviors.F8_providerhub_open_tracker: PASS — /provider my-deliveries-section contains 8 provider-track-{id} links to /jobs/{id}/track.
verified_behaviors.F9_providerhub_dismiss_persist: PASS — 37 dismiss-job-{id} buttons rendered on opportunity rows; click optimistically removes the row, and after a full reload the row stays hidden, confirming dismissed_jobs persistence on the user document. Undismissed for cleanup.

critical_code_review_comments: ChatPanel: customer-tracker page works, but ChatPanel doesn't have a 'job-chat-panel' data-testid — only the surrounding <aside> was used to detect it. Consider adding data-testid to ChatPanel root for more robust test targeting.

LiveTrack.jsx polls GET /api/jobs/{id}/tracking every 5 s using setInterval. For long-lived sessions this is fine, but consider switching to WebSocket / SSE later for ETA accuracy and lower cost as adoption grows.
Backend /api/jobs/{id}/location accepts arbitrary lat/lng with no range check (-90..90, -180..180). Add Pydantic ge/le validators on LocationPing to reject obviously invalid coordinates.

Backend update_tracking_status: when body.status='accepted' (allowed by TRACKING_STATUSES) no notification is sent (correct), but tracking_timestamps.accepted is still overwritten on every call. Minor: consider $setOnInsert-style logic so an accidental re-accept doesn't reset the original accepted timestamp.

Frontend route is /customer and /provider — not /hub/customer or /hub/provider. The previous iteration tests in this repo refer to /hub/* in some places; verify all docs/links are consistent with App.js routes.
